newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, except static fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, except static fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Wednesday following bullish U.S. stocks data, except for fuel oil which was steady and quiet, dealers said.
Gasoline's march higher continued with a rise of about $3 a tonne in swaps. Cash prices were also higher, although parties remained nervous.
"We've had the (API) stats in the U.S. and ACCESS (trading of NYMEX unleaded futures) is up around 100 points," one trader said.
The market took some time before the first deal, a $206 fob Rotterdam for first half August, was concluded.
Eurograde was talked at $206/$208 fob AR for immediate delivery with one major eager to fix for Thursday. First half August loadings were valued at around $206 fob Rotterdam.
Offers for second half deliveries also rose, but at levels equivalent to the swaps market, few expressed interest in buying.
Heating oil barges were about $2 a tonne higher as IPE gas oil futures rose. Prompt discussions were muted. Offers remained at about IPE August +50 cents fob Rotterdam.
"It's certainly not extremely firm, but there's also no evidence of cash weakness," one trader said.
High sulphur fuel oil barge offers stuck at $92 fob Rotterdam. Bids were at around $90, leaving the market unchanged from late on Tuesday. No early deals emerged in a very quiet market.
